h2. User Story

As a payment analyst, I want to see settlement disputes broken down by reason code and outcome so that I can identify the most common dispute causes and track resolution effectiveness.

h2. Business Context

Settlement disputes arise when there is a discrepancy between what the merchant expected to receive and what was actually settled. Currently, dispute data is available at an aggregate level, but analysts lack visibility into the distribution of disputes by reason code (e.g., processing error, duplicate transaction, late presentment) and their outcomes (won, lost, pending). This breakdown is essential for identifying systemic issues in the settlement process and prioritizing operational improvements.

h2. Acceptance Criteria

# A breakdown of settlement disputes is available by reason code
# Each reason code shows the count, total amount, and win/loss outcome distribution
# The data is queryable through the Cortex Agent using natural language
# The breakdown covers at least the last 12 months of dispute data

h2. Priority

Low

h2. Labels

settlements, reporting
